method: Babel Program-scope binding dependency closure; original declaration slices retained in source order; no target evaluation

limitations: Recovered codecs are emitted JavaScript, not original .proto or TypeScript sources.
This module only serializes/deserializes data. It does not authenticate, start an engine, grant a license, or report backend readiness.
The original encoder permits payloads up to u32; the decoder defaults to a 16 MiB limit. Apply an application-specific outbound size limit when needed.
